question: How many products are in the catalog?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM products

question: How many customers are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers

question: How many product categories exist?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM categories

question: How many customers live in the USA?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers WHERE country = 'USA'

question: List customer names from Germany
gold_sql: SELECT full_name FROM customers WHERE country = 'Germany'

question: List product names in the Electronics category
gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Electronics' ORDER BY p.name

question: Which products are in the Books category?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Books' ORDER BY p.name

question: What is the most expensive product?
gold_sql: SELECT name, unit_price FROM products ORDER BY unit_price DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the cheapest product?
gold_sql: SELECT name, unit_price FROM products ORDER BY unit_price ASC LIMIT 1

question: Which products have stock quantity under 100?
gold_sql: SELECT name, stock_quantity FROM products WHERE stock_quantity < 100 ORDER BY stock_quantity

question: How many orders were cancelled?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'

question: How many orders have status shipped?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders WHERE status = 'shipped'

question: How many completed orders are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed'

question: List all customer cities
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT city FROM customers ORDER BY city

question: Show the top 5 products by sales
gold_sql: SELECT p.name AS product, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS sales FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is total revenue excluding cancelled orders?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled'

question: What is the average order value for completed orders?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(order_total), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM (SELECT o.id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS order_total FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.id) AS order_totals

question: How many orders did Ava Nguyen place?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.full_name = 'Ava Nguyen'

question: Which customers ordered Running Shoes?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.full_name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE p.name = 'Running Shoes' ORDER BY c.full_name

question: How many Wireless Headphones units were sold excluding cancelled orders?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE p.name = 'Wireless Headphones' AND o.status != 'cancelled'

question: How many orders were placed in March 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-03-01' AND order_date < '2025-04-01'

question: How many products are in each category?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name AS category, COUNT(p.id) AS product_count FROM categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY c.name

question: List customers who have placed at least one order
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.full_name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id ORDER BY c.full_name

question: How many order line items are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_items

question: What is the stock quantity for Desk Lamp?
gold_sql: SELECT stock_quantity FROM products WHERE name = 'Desk Lamp'

question: What is the email of the customer in Canada?
gold_sql: SELECT email FROM customers WHERE country = 'Canada'

question: List Sports category product names
gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Sports' ORDER BY p.name

question: How many Home category products are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Home'

question: What is the latest order date?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(order_date) AS latest_order_date FROM orders

question: What is the earliest order date?
gold_sql: SELECT MIN(order_date) AS earliest_order_date FROM orders

question: Show total sales by category excluding cancelled orders
gold_sql: SELECT c.name AS category, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS sales FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY sales DESC

question: Which customer spent the most excluding cancelled orders?
gold_sql: SELECT c.full_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS spend FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.id, c.full_name ORDER BY spend DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the average number of line items per order?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(item_count), 2) AS avg_items FROM (SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) AS per_order

question: Which products were never ordered?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE oi.id IS NULL ORDER BY p.name

question: Show total quantity sold per product excluding cancelled orders
gold_sql: SELECT p.name AS product, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY units DESC
